decisions.scenario: Finding an expensive Chinese restaurant in the south

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like to find a restaurant that serves Chinese food in the south.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are three Chinese restaurants in the south. Would you like more information about one of them?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. I would prefer an expensive one.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Two options are on the expensive side: Good Luck Chinese Food Takeaway and Peking Restaurant. Would you like a reservation at either one?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Not yet, thanks. Could you give me the address and postcode for Peking Restaurant?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Peking Restaurant is at 10 Homerton Street, City Centre, and the postcode is CB2 8NX.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: All right. That sounds good.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that is all. Thanks!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are welcome. Have a great day!

decisions.scenario: Finding and booking a Korean restaurant in the centre

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I am looking for a restaurant in the centre that serves world food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I cannot find any world-food restaurants in the centre.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How about a restaurant in the centre that serves Korean food?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Little Seoul fits that description. Would you like me to book a table?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please. I would like a table for seven on Tuesday at 11:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There is nothing available at that time. Would you like a different day or time at the same restaurant?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How about 10:15?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have booked a table for seven at Little Seoul on Tuesday at 10:15. Your reference number is KAHFBHYI.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you so much for your help. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Glad I could help. Goodbye!
